summary: This topic covers the ability to customize the layout and content of the fee receipt generated by the ERP, including adding the institutional logo and displaying specific transaction details.
steps: Provide the institutional logo to the ERP team for integration into the receipt template.
Share any specific design requirements or desired content for the receipt template.
The ERP team will customize the receipt to include the logo, fee heads, installment details, collected amount, remarks, and other relevant information.
business_rules: The receipt will accurately display the collected amount and any remarks entered during the collection process.
Concession details will be reflected on the receipt if a concession was applied.
important_notes: The institutional logo should be shared with the ERP team (e.g., via a shared group) for proper integration.
Customization is possible if a specific receipt design or template is provided.
questions: Can we customize the format and content of the fee receipt?

What information is typically displayed on the fee receipt?
